issue: CRUX audit — architecture, performance and competitive research (docs-only; spawned #403-#417)
change_shape: DOCS-ONLY. One new file, docs/specifications/forjar-architecture-crux-audit.md. No source, no tests, no CI config. The falsification discipline this gate exists to enforce does not apply to a document in the usual way -- there is no production hunk to revert. What IS falsifiable about an audit is whether its claims reproduce, and that is what the adversarial lane tested.

quorum.lens_diversity: 9 independent read-only lenses: 3 architecture, 2 performance, 4 competitive
quorum.kill_rule: a claim survives only with file:line or a measured number; all 9 lenses self-reported evidence_quality=measured
quorum.notable_kill: The adversarial reviewer charged that 2 of 7 critical findings were 'silently dropped' because only 5 candidates were P0. REFUTED with evidence: all 7 map to E01-E07; E06 and E07 are ranked P1 because they are dormant (they mislead a score and a status table, but no config a user writes executes the broken path). The severity-vs-priority rule is now stated explicitly in the document's section 3 rather than left implicit.
refuted_claims: synthesis silently dropped 2 critical findings (rejected -- see notable_kill)
quorum.divergence: The reviewer and the synthesis disagreed on E13's priority. Reviewer said P0 (key on argv is credential disclosure to every local user); synthesis had P2. I verified independently at lock_core_args.rs:187-189 before accepting -- `--key: String` documented 'path to key file or inline'. Reviewer was right; escalated.

falsification.method: For a document, falsification means: can an independent party reproduce the load-bearing claims from source? Four of the seven criticals were handed to `agy --mode plan` with instructions to reproduce or refute them.
reproduced_independently: E01 -- confirmed: hashing.rs collects ~35 fields, `uid` (resource.rs:110) absent from both collectors, planner/mod.rs:362-366 returns NoOp on hash equality
E02 -- confirmed: apply_preflight.rs:89-96 loops machines sequentially with full handshakes; ControlMaster starts later at machine.rs:78
E03 -- confirmed, and STRONGER than written: reviewer found lock_audit.rs:184-188 increments verified+=1 purely if sig_path.exists(), without even hashing
E05 -- confirmed: mcp/handlers.rs:218 calls detect_drift(&lock_data), skipping machine context
verified_by_me_before_filing: E13 key-on-argv: lock_core_args.rs:187-189 `--key: String` doc-commented 'path to key file or inline'
E14 prove-passes-UNKNOWN: prove.rs:82 'FALSIFIED fails the proof; PROVED/CHECKED/UNKNOWN pass'
E06 store-not-on-apply-path: grep -rln 'core::store' src/core/executor src/core/planner src/resources -> empty

crux.note: This lane is not adjacent to the change -- it IS the change. Four of the nine lenses were competitive.
crux.verdict: forjar leads on persisted drift baseline, post-apply host verification, compile-to-shell auditability and formal spine; trails on facts model, live-host plan, provider ecosystem and asymmetric signing. The gaps are enumerated as E11, E12, E13 and the ecosystem finding.

agy_teamwork.mode: agy --mode plan (plan-mode review, as the user specified 'review with agy plan')
unique_findings: E13 must be P0 -- key on argv (accepted, verified, escalated)
E14's success criterion was unfalsifiable: it depended on humans applying a [verified] tag (accepted, replaced with two mechanical assertions)
'Institutionalised honesty' and 'compile-to-shell auditability' were graded too generously (accepted, both qualified in place)

pmat.reason: NOT RUN, and not claimed. pmat grades code; this change adds no code. Running it would produce a number about files this diff does not touch. Recorded as skipped rather than quietly omitted.

waived.reason: The 3-refuter / 3-judge panel did not sit. One adversarial lane ran (agy --mode plan) and returned SOUND-WITH-CORRECTIONS with 4 accepted corrections and 1 rejected charge. The numbers in `quorum` are the real counts -- 1 refuter, 1 judge -- not 3s written to clear a floor. Inflating them is the single failure this receipt system exists to prevent. This is a docs-only change whose entire content is 118 measured findings, each individually checkable against the file:line it cites; a reviewer can falsify any claim in it directly.
waived.what_would_close_it: a 3-refuter panel re-deriving E01-E15 independently from the raw lens output
